description:
The Firmstrong Siren Lady 3-Speed, formerly known as the Chief Lady, is the ideal beach cruiser for women who want the classic cruiser look with the added power of gears. Although the frame measures 17 inches, its extended length and 4-inch forward pedaling design make it a perfect fit for taller riders between 5 feet 4 inches and 6 feet 4 inches. Even for those outside that height range, the unique geometry provides an exceptionally comfortable and stable ride that standard cruisers cannot match.

The defining feature of the Siren is the forward pedaling setup, where the pedals are shifted 4 inches in front of the seat instead of directly underneath the hips. In a traditional design, you push directly downward, but the Siren allows you to push slightly down and forward. This creates significant added leg room for taller women without needing to raise the seat to an uncomfortable height, allowing you to get full leg extension while staying closer to the ground. This laid-back position allows you to maintain a straight back with your feet kicked forward, which takes the pressure off your hips and gives you a greater sense of stability when stopping and starting.

Equipped with a Shimano 3-speed internal gear system, the Siren Lady is much more versatile than a single-speed bike. This setup is built to handle hills and inclines with ease while keeping maintenance to a minimum since the gears are protected inside the rear hub. The frame remains clean and sleek, featuring a high-arched top tube that dips low for easy mounting and dismounting. It combines the functionality of a geared bike with the classic, feminine aesthetic of a beach cruiser. The Siren Lady 3-Speed is a long, elegant bicycle designed for women who want a high-quality ride that is as comfortable and relaxed as it is capable.

17” Extended Length Steel Frame with 26” Painted Aluminum Wheels and Front/Rear Fenders

3 Speed Women's Bike with Shimano Internal Gear System, shifts quickly, easily, and requires little maintenance

Great recreational riding bike for taller women or those who would like more leg and arm extension. 4” extended frame creates more space between rider and handlebars.

Forward pedaling design allows riders to keep seat closer to ground while still getting proper leg extension

Frame Geometry makes riders feel less cramped, creating a more “kicked back,” “relaxed” ride

Circular, High Arching Top Tube Frame Design

Dual Spring Oversized Seat for Added Comfort

2.125” Wide White-Wall Tires provide a cushioned, relaxed ride for easy rolling

28.5” Wide Chrome Plated Cruiser Bike Handlebars with Synthetic Leather Grips

Bicycle Weighs 38.5 lbs. Fully Assembled

Fits Most Women 5’4” – 6’4” Tall

Recommended Riding Speed 3 – 25mph

Recommended Riding Distance 0 – 35miles in a single trip

The Seat and Handlebar Height and Tilt can be adjusted to properly fit the rider

Bike comes 85% Assembled, Assembly is easy and fun!

Designed in Hermosa Beach, CA.
